rooms_create_error: Could not create the room. Please try again.
rooms_bot_description: Name the bot, give it instructions and pick the model it runs on.
rooms_bot_instructions_placeholder: Personality, role and tone. For example: a calm reviewer who answers in short bullet points.
rooms_bot_create_error: Could not create the bot. Check the fields and use an available handle.
rooms_bot_daemon_needed: Connect a daemon first: it lists the models it can run.
rooms_bot_pi_missing: pi isn't installed where the daemon runs. Install pi, then restart the daemon.
rooms_bot_pi_outdated: pi {version} is too old. Update pi to {minimum} or newer, then restart the daemon.
rooms_bot_daemon_outdated: The daemon is older than this server. Update the daemon, then restart it.
rooms_bot_server_outdated: This server is older than the daemon. Update the server.
rooms_bot_save_error: Could not save the bot. Please try again.
rooms_daemon_key_hint: Create a key and paste the line into apps/daemon/.env. It is shown only once.
rooms_bot_home_hint: Where the bot keeps its files. Leave it empty for the default.
rooms_route_mention: Mentioned by name, so they answer.
rooms_route_direct: The only bot in this room answers.
rooms_route_vision: The message has an image, and this is the only bot here that can see images.
rooms_route_jev: Jev scored every member, and these fit best.
rooms_route_none: No bot needed to answer this.
rooms_route_budget: The reply budget for this message is spent, so no bot was woken.
rooms_chat_failed_pi_missing: {bot} couldn't reply: pi isn't installed where the daemon runs.
rooms_chat_failed_pi_outdated: {bot} couldn't reply: pi {version} is too old. Update pi to {minimum} or newer.
rooms_chat_failed_model_unavailable: {bot} couldn't reply: pi doesn't offer its model.
rooms_chat_failed_model_error: {bot} couldn't reply: the model returned an error.
rooms_route_error: Jev failed, so the leader answers.
rooms_route_error_none: Jev failed, so no bot was woken.
rooms_send_mode: New messages while a bot works
rooms_send_steer_hint: Goes into the working bot's turn, after its current tool calls
rooms_route_steer: Sent into the bot's running turn as a steer.
rooms_bot_inherit_mcp: Also use the shared MCP servers
rooms_bot_inherit_plugins: Also use this computer’s Pi plugins
rooms_absent_none: {bot} is in no group room yet.
rooms_fresh_done: Fresh start: earlier messages are forgotten here.
rooms_fresh_failed: Could not start fresh. Try again once the bot is done replying.
rooms_reset_description: {bot} forgets the earlier messages in this room and starts fresh. Saved memories stay.
rooms_reset_all_description: Every bot here forgets the earlier messages in this room and starts fresh. Saved memories stay.
rooms_route_lead: No member was a clear fit, so the room's leader answers.
rooms_media_empty_hint: Images and files shared in this room will show up here.
rooms_delete_description: This deletes the room, its messages and the bots' sessions here. It cannot be undone.
rooms_bot_permission_read_only_hint: Reads and searches files. It cannot edit, run commands or use MCP tools.
rooms_bot_permission_ask_hint: Reads on its own, and asks someone in the room before it edits a file or runs a command.
rooms_bot_permission_auto_hint: Runs what looks safe for the request, and asks someone in the room before anything risky.
rooms_bot_permission_full_hint: Runs any tool without asking, as your user on the daemon's computer.
rooms_chat_approval_gone: This request is no longer waiting.
rooms_chat_approval_error: Your answer was not sent. Try again.
rooms_route_reaction: The reaction goes to the reply's author.
rooms_route_reply: A reply to a bot's message wakes that bot.
rooms_route_roundtable: Roundtable: members take turns in order, and the leader closes.
rooms_route_judge: The judge model read the conversation and picked these bots.
rooms_reaction_failed: The reaction was not saved. Try again.
rooms_reaction_slow: Emoji are taking long to load.
rooms_settings_hint: The room's name, purpose and who answers.
rooms_bot_delete_description: This removes the bot from every group and deletes its direct chat. Its past group messages and files on your computer stay. This cannot be undone.
rooms_bot_delete_error: Could not delete the bot. Try again.
rooms_chat_no_members: This room has no members. Open Settings to add one.
memory_hint: You can correct or forget saved facts. Old conversations may still contain forgotten details.
memory_global: Shared by all bots in this organization
memory_bot: Used by this bot across its rooms
memory_room: Shared by bots in this room
memory_error: Could not load or save memory. An edit may have changed its revision; refresh and try again.
memory_capture_hint: Capture starts with new messages. Select a memory model in organization settings first.
memory_skip_hint: Skip leaves the source chat intact but does not extract this range.
memory_model_hint: Used for background room facts and recaps. No model means automatic processing is off.
validation_memory_sources: This memory has too many source messages to combine.
validation_memory_secret: Remove secrets before saving this memory.
memory_capture_reason: Capture could not finish. Check the memory model and daemon connection, then retry.
memory_refresh_pending: Memory is refreshing. Replies continue without this scope until it is ready.
memory_source_unavailable: Original message is no longer available
memory_wipe_room_description: This permanently removes every saved memory in this room. Bot and organization memories stay. Automatic capture, if enabled, continues with new messages.
memory_wipe_bot_description: This permanently removes this bot’s saved memories across rooms. Room and organization memories stay.
memory_wipe_history_hint: Chat history and existing conversations stay and may still contain these facts. This cannot be undone.
memory_wipe_error: Memories could not be cleared. Try again.
rooms_files_failed: A file did not upload. Remove it and try again.
rooms_files_too_big: Files can be up to 10 MB.
rooms_files_type: Use images (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF) or PDF, text, Markdown, CSV or JSON files.
rooms_files_blind: {bots} can't see images. Remove the image or mention another bot.
